data.current_summary: Search Individual Agreement by various criteria
data.current_description:
The divisions collection supports information and processes relating to divisions, products, provisions and eligibility classes as applicable. A listing of a client's current divisions is provided under the /clients resource collection. Added at v1.0.0.
### Combined Search criteria fields Supported by the Operation
- Source System ConsumerId, Social Security Number, Birth Date and Source System Text
- Social Security Number, Birth Date and Source System Text
- Source System ConsumerId and Source System Text
- Policy Number, Last Name and Source System Text 
### Combined Search criteria fields not supported by the Operation
- Social Security Number and Source System Text
- First Name, Last Name, Birth Date and Source System Text
- First Name, Last Name, Postal Code and Source System Text

### Search criteria fields not supported by the Operation
- Exclude Individual Agreement Coverage
- First Name
- Last Name
- Postal Code
data.summary_suggestion: Search individual agreements by supported criteria
data.description_suggestion: Searches for individual agreements using supported combinations of criteria. Supported search parameter combinations include: (1) Source System ConsumerId, Social Security Number, Birth Date, and Source System Text; (2) Social Security Number, Birth Date, and Source System Text; (3) Source System ConsumerId and Source System Text; (4) Policy Number, Last Name, and Source System Text. Returns a collection of matching individual agreement records. Note: Unsupported search combinations include SSN with Source System Text alone, or combinations using First Name, Last Name, Postal Code, or Coverage exclusion filters.
